snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection – Demo Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on March 13, 2026. Download the free demo and pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/monster-hunter-stories-3-twisted-reflection-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01   

In this turn-based, story-rich RPG set in the world of Monster Hunter, you'll raise, ride, and battle with iconic monsters from the Monster Hunter series, including fan-favorites featured in Monster Hunter Rise.

Play the opening hours of the game with the free demo and continue your progress by transferring your save data when the full game is released.

#MHStories3 #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect
